description: Find parts of the current Cut Once plan by name or alias, for example 'stretcher' or 'back left leg'. Returns stable part ids.

configuration.query: FROM cutonce-parts METADATA _score | WHERE MATCH(name, ?query) OR MATCH(aliases, ?query) | SORT _score DESC | KEEP part_id, name, layer, step_id, dims_text | LIMIT 5

query.description: Words from the part's name or alias
